definitions: Last axis is channel K; reduce all other axes. Exact maxima over all 1024 calibration roots. Mean and RMS are elementwise aggregate statistics. Quantiles are across channel maxima, not elementwise activation percentiles.
precision: FP32 source-network instrumented diagnostic; TF32 off. Not fused TRT internal values or production latency.
shared_consumer_rules: An explicit branch Div plus compensation of each selected XW weight can preserve untouched residual/unselected branches. Moving a scale into upstream normalization requires compensating every consumer. Shared Smolgen weights require one scale consistent across every use, or explicitly cloned weights with storage changes disclosed. Do not smooth each occurrence of a shared initializer independently.
figure_render_note: Same saved statistics, logarithmic histogram axis to show all tensors despite one extreme max/median ratio; no new model inference or altered statistics.
